peopleAlsoAsk.question: Does Voi make money?
peopleAlsoAsk.title: Profitable at Scale? Voi's Q2 2025 Says Yes! - Micromobility Industries
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Voi Technology's Q2 2025 results are out, and they show the clearest signs yet that shared micromobility can scale profitably. The Swedish operator reported €46.8 million in net revenue, up 29 percent year over year, making this its strongest quarter on record.Aug 1, 2025

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the Series B round of funding?
peopleAlsoAsk.title: Series B Financing: Definition, Examples, and Funding Sources
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Series B financing is the second round of funding for a business through investment, including private equity investors and venture capitalists. Successive rounds of financing a business are consecutively termed Series A, Series B, and Series C financing.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is Voi safe to use?
peopleAlsoAsk.title: Our commitment to safety - Voi
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Our safety features include speed limits in high-risk areas, technology that prevents pavement and intoxicated riding, and real-time parking guidance. We also offer structured education through our online learning platform, RideSafe Academy.

Fredrik Hjelm

Fredrik co-founded Voi in 2018 with a bold vision: to transform urban mobility and reclaim city streets for people, not cars.
